about: The e2e stack every suite runs against: Pane View built and served by e2e/scripts/start-pane-view.ts on its own database and bucket, seeded by pushing the fixture archive through the Lockstep CLI. e2e/src/env.ts reads this file, and so do Oriel's Sync stack tests, sync_bench and xtask measure, so no value is copied elsewhere. Pane View listens on http://127.0.0.1:<port>. Paths are relative to this file.
